purpose: Validate immutable point-in-time official-source ingestion and deterministic low-dimensional event extraction; do not test a price model.
hypothesis: Official release archives can be converted into replayable event records, while FOMC wording changes can be represented by a fixed small set of predeclared lexical axes without fitting a high-dimensional predictor.

eia.expected_release_time: 10:30 America/New_York unless a holiday schedule says otherwise

event_schema.storage: content-addressed raw bytes plus SQLite manifest
event_schema.version_rule: A new content hash under the same source_event_id creates a new immutable version; an identical re-fetch creates only an observation.
event_schema.historical_limit: first_seen_at and received_at describe this archive fetch, not the original real-time arrival. Inferred release times must be labeled as inferred.

extractor.name: fixed_lexicon_diff_v1
extractor.comparison: previous FOMC statement in publication order
extractor.interpretation: model inputs for later testing, not causal contributions and not trading signals

decision_rule.PASS_PIPELINE_ONLY: All completion gates pass. This authorizes a separately preregistered vendor/feature study, not trading.
decision_rule.FAIL_PIPELINE: Any immutable-storage, provenance, replay, source-count, dimension or test gate fails.

out_of_scope: historical real-time arrival reconstruction from archive fetch timestamps
